transcriber_notes: Avanet PDF; measured on the embedded 6160x2832 chart raster (12.27 px/cm). Boundaries printed on the right axis (200, 191, 177, 157, 156, 145, 80) and confirmed by bar edges and leader lines. Hardness from bar left edges vs grey gridlines (260 px per class, bars grow leftward from F; thirds as +/-). Temperature axis is in deg F (-16..32 F); converted to deg C. Calibration: 0 C (32 F) at x=2115 px, 46.7 px/C (= 25.96 px/F from the label spacing); this makes every vertex in this chart and the companion 2019-02-18 chart fall on whole or half degrees C, and the 02-18 air-temperature dash ends at ~-13 F as printed (+-0.2 C). The red polyline (no markers) runs only from 190 to 140 cm; break points recorded (-18.0 C at 190 cm, i.e. ~0 F).
